summary: Milestone 2 verification: enriched 'Opening / Introduction' canonical domain (~31 fields) end-to-end. Backend pytest: 16/17 passed initially with a single failure (TestTwoStageSelection assertion that reasoner_prompt_bytes <=12KB) — that assertion pre-dated Milestone 2 and no longer holds because the enriched Opening record adds ~15KB when selected. Adjusted the threshold to <=26KB (still well below the ~35KB full-model payload) and added a dedicated /app/backend/tests/test_milestone2_opening.py with 7 assertions all passing. Full run: 17/17 pass in ~245s combined. Per-turn logs confirm reasoner_prompt_bytes ~22.5KB when Opening is selected and ~6-8KB when it is not — two-stage selection still bounds the payload; the whole 13-domain model is NOT being sent every turn. All 3 introduction turns (writing -> revise -> answer) returned HTTP 200 with `event: done` in <60s each; theory_history grew v1..v3 with prior theories preserved and changes_since_previous transitioned off 'initial' after turn 1. theory.alternative_interpretations was populated on every turn (>=1 non-empty item) and Opening / Introduction was selected in currently_relevant_domains on the introduction turn. Invitation did NOT rewrite the student's paragraph, did NOT demand a catchy hook, and did NOT force a fixed thesis position — matching Milestone 2's engine contract. Frontend Playwright: full flow via public URL passed — TeacherSetup (input-* + begin-session-button) -> StudentWorkspace (writing-area + continue-button, ai-invitation rendered) -> dev panel (open-dev-panel-button -> development-panel) surfaces 'Currently Relevant Canonical Domains' showing 'Opening / Introduction' + 'Central Claim / Thesis', a new 'Alternative Interpretations (preserved)' block with 2 preserved readings, 2 candidate-invitation-N cards, and selected-invitation. Teacher telos edit (toggle-telos-editor -> telos-edit-current_writing_task -> save-telos-button) fired the 'Telos revised' toast and the StudentWorkspace header immediately reflected the new task. Reload via localStorage dws_session_id restored the AI + student bubbles.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py:_build_compact_domain_index — correctly falls back to governing_communicative_function (used by the enriched Opening record) and then to possible_communicative_functions. STAGE A index remains small (name + one-sentence function + relationships); single source of truth for the canonical model is canonical_writing_model.json.

server.py:DevelopmentalTheory — the new generic alternative_interpretations: List[str] field is a proper domain-independent addition (not introduction-specific). It is included in _compact_theory() so it survives into the next turn's reasoner prompt (~29 chars added to the compact projection).
server.py:_apply_engine_result — theory_history snapshotting order is unchanged and correct; the new alternative_interpretations field participates automatically via DevelopmentalTheory.model_dump().

canonical_writing_model.json Opening / Introduction — enriched with governing_communicative_function, possible_communicative_functions, observable_organizations A-L, possible_differentiations/integrations/coordinations, common_productive_tensions, alternative_interpretations, common_misunderstandings, possible_developmental_movements, candidate_developmental_invitations, invitation_construction_rules, relationships_to_other_domains, genre_sensitivity, inside_outside_coordination, prohibitions. All 13 domains still parse; other 12 domains structurally unchanged.

DevelopmentPanel.jsx — new 'Alternative Interpretations (preserved)' Block renders theory.alternative_interpretations via the existing <List/> pattern; renders '—' when empty. Placement (after Complicating Evidence, before Current Uncertainty) is coherent with the surrounding evidential blocks.

Consistency observation: the review request enumerates the Opening record's fields as 'differentiations / integrations / coordinations', but the JSON keys are 'possible_differentiations / possible_integrations / possible_coordinations'. Both spellings surface in the LLM prompt via the raw record so this is a documentation drift only — not a functional issue. If the plan is to normalize field names across domains, worth aligning.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Run BOTH files serially: `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_developmental_engine.py /app/backend/tests/test_milestone2_opening.py -v -n 0`. Combined runtime is ~4-5 minutes because each turn is a live LLM call. Milestone 2 makes reasoner_prompt_bytes spike to ~22-24KB whenever 'Opening / Introduction' is one of the selected domains; when Opening is not selected the prompt returns to the ~5-8KB range (see /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log for '[interact] turn domains=... reasoner_prompt_bytes=NNNN'). The generic theory.alternative_interpretations field is populated by the LLM on every turn regardless of domain (it lives in DevelopmentalTheory, not in Opening); the DevelopmentPanel renders it under 'Alternative Interpretations (preserved)'. If future work adds more enriched domains, keep the threshold in TestTwoStageSelection (currently 26KB) aligned with the empirical ceiling to catch runaway payload regressions.
rca of the issue: N/A — Milestone 2 acceptance passed end-to-end. Two-stage domain selection continues to bound the reasoner prompt (~22.5KB with Opening / Introduction included; ~5-8KB without); all 3 intro turns completed under 60s; theory_history preserves prior theories; theory.alternative_interpretations is populated on every turn and rendered in the DevelopmentPanel; the AI does not rewrite the student text and does not impose a hook or fixed thesis position. The pre-Milestone-2 ~12KB prompt-size test threshold no longer holds because the enriched Opening record intentionally added ~15KB of structured guidance to that domain; the threshold was raised to 26KB with an inline comment documenting why.
